prompt-squeeze.mode.description: off: hook disabled. advise: nudge Claude to /squeeze (v0.3 behavior). interactive: block prompts above block_threshold and offer /sq y (v0.4 default). measure: log only. replace: reserved for native prompt rewrite when Anthropic ships #27365.

prompt-squeeze.block_threshold.description: v0.4: prompts above this token count are blocked in interactive mode. Default 500.

prompt-squeeze.warn_threshold.description: Legacy v0.3 advise-mode threshold. Honored when mode == 'advise'.

prompt-squeeze.interactive.description: Legacy v0.3 setting. Folded into mode='interactive' in v0.4 — ignored when mode is set.

prompt-squeeze.explain.description: When 'on', the hook stores per-squeeze explain artifacts at ~/.claude/prompt-squeeze/explain/. Required for /sq explain and /sq undo. Off by default — explicit opt-in.
